recipe.name: Peach Julep
recipe.description: A floral and fruity variation on a classic Julep, blending smooth Scotch whisky with sweet muddled peach, bright lime, and aromatic mint.
steps: Muddle the peach slices, mint leaves, lime juice, and simple syrup (if using) directly in a Julep cup.
Add Dewar's White Label and aromatic bitters.
Fill the cup two-thirds full with crushed ice and stir briskly until chilled and frosty on the outside.
Pack the glass with additional crushed ice to form a dome on top.
recipe.serving: Serve immediately over crushed ice with a straw.
